aiResearchSummary.text: Shared resource allocation for multiple queue processing describes allocating remote agents across multiple queues at different locations, such as agents taking orders at a restaurant. The abstract explains how agents are dynamically assigned among queues to process user requests efficiently. Bite Ninja is researching and developing systems for remote agent management, multi queue request handling, and shared resource allocation for restaurant order processing and related services.
